title: Proxima Forma — Design at the speed of AI
excerpt: Your creative direction, agents do the work. Explore visual design with ChatGPT, Claude, or your custom agent in a shared workspace.

Submit your projects to be featured.

Built for the way you create

One shared canvas

You and your agents work in the same visual space, with the same context.

Always editable

Agent output stays as real layers and components—not flattened screenshots.

Bring references

Give your agents visual references so they can follow the direction instead of guessing.

Works with your favorite agent

Keep using ChatGPT, Claude, or your custom agent. Don’t reinvent the wheel—bring the tooling you already use.

Fits your current workflow

Add Proxima Forma to the way you already work instead of rebuilding your process around another tool.

Share and collaborate

Bring people and agents into the same design space, share progress, and keep everyone working from the same source.

Pay as you go

Pay for what you consume as you work. Start small, scale naturally, and avoid paying for unused capacity.

Keep your agent tooling

Use the prompts, models, integrations, and agent stack you already trust—just give them a real design canvas.

How it works
